faq.q: How much does Law Office of Michael H. Joseph charge?
faq.a: Law Office of Michael H. Joseph publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Law Office of Michael H. Joseph offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Law Office of Michael H. Joseph publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Law Office of Michael H. Joseph have offices?
faq.a: Law Office of Michael H. Joseph publishes three offices, in Manhattan, White Plains and Forest Hills. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Office of Michael H. Joseph?
faq.a: Law Office of Michael H. Joseph names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 2 of 2 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status.

faq.q: Are the case results Law Office of Michael H. Joseph publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Law Office of Michael H. Joseph publishes 14 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Law Office of Michael H. Joseph?
faq.a: Law Office of Michael H. Joseph scores 69 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
